translation: and blue (תְּכֵלֶת), and purple (אַרְגָּמָן), and worm-scarlet (תּוֹלַעַת שָׁנִי), and fine linen (שֵׁשׁ), and goats' hair.

tokens.marks: technically 'wool dyed with תְּכֵלֶת' (blue-violet from the hillazon snail), rendered here as the color substance itself
technically 'wool dyed with אַרְגָּמָן' (crimson-purple from the murex snail)
construct noun modifying שָׁנִי (the worm/insect source of the dye)
the crimson color/yarn produced by the scale insect (Kermes vermilio)
technically 'twisted linen' (from שֵׁשׁ / שִׁישׁ), a costly white fabric
noun in construct chain, modifying the elided 'hair' or 'skins' (עִזִּים)
